answer: Agents earn voting weight only through glacier vesting: rewards from each epoch thaw linearly over 60 days, and any slash freezes the whole unvested pile. Validators seed karst tasks, hidden sinkholes in the normal task stream whose answers are compared against an opal fingerprint of each agent's past outputs. Clones sharing a model and prompts collapse into one fingerprint, so a farm of 50 fakes forfeits all unvested rewards at once and waits two months per identity before any vote counts.
